reason: Studies Kir7.1 (KCNJ13 protein) directly: Kir7.1 deletion and blocker experiments, MC4R-Kir7.1 coupling. Gene product biology is on topic, though the context is hypothalamic feeding rather than retina.
Kinetin derivatives correcting ELP1 (IKBKAP) splicing in familial dysautonomia. ELP1 is not ELP4; no ELP4 or aliases (C11orf19, PAXNEB) involved.
Book chapter on paraneoplastic vision loss with no abstract. Not specific to LRIT3 or CSNB1F.
Syncytin-a deficiency in murine sperm function. No BBS10 link; BBS10 aliases not mentioned.
Short rib-polydactyly syndrome caused by DYNC2I1 variant. DYNC2I1 is a distinct gene from BBS10; the ciliopathy overlap alone does not make it BBS10-relevant.
Kir2.1 (KCNJ2) mutations in Andersen syndrome. Different Kir subfamily member from KCNJ13 (Kir7.1).
General review of CNS potassium buffering. No KCNJ13 or Kir7.1 specificity.
Biophysics review of multi-ion pores in delayed and inward rectifier K channels. Generic, not KCNJ13-specific.
Dopamine signaling and myopia review. No LRIT3 or CSNB link.
Mg2+ affinity in an inward-rectifier K channel (Kir2.x family, not Kir7.1). Not KCNJ13-specific.
